title: Bee 18S and 28S rRNA Library Preparation
author: Brian Darby
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bapqidmw
materials: Lyse tissue at room temperature overnight, then pulverize for 10 min in a TissueLyser prior to proceeding with the desired genomic DNA extraction kit instructions (e.g. Qiagen 96-well Tissue and Cells kit). Elute DNA into 60 ul elution buffer, pH 8.0.
Amplify first round PCR reactions in a thermocycler with 30 cycles of 95 °C for 0:30, 55 °C for 0:30, and 72 °C for 0:30, followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 5 minutes.
For each sample, add reagents to an appropriate PCR reaction tube (or well of a 96-well plate):
Amplify second round PCR reactions in a thermocycler with 8 cycles of 95 °C for 0:30, 55 °C for 0:30, and 72 °C for 0:30, followed by a final extension at 72 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Prepare Specimen Samples
steps.instruction: Place one mesothoracic leg from each specimen of a sample into a 2.0 ml microcentrifuge tube, using new tubes for samples to be separately barcoded.

steps.title: Perform DNA Extraction
steps.instruction: Add lysis components to each tube containing the specimen legs.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 ul genomic lysis buffer from a DNA extraction kit (e.g. Qiagen 96-well Tissue and Cells)
Optional: Add two mealworm beetle (Tenebrio molitar) legs as inter-sample controls

steps.title: Prepare First-Round PCR
steps.instruction: Prepare Master Mix 1 for each locus (18S and 28S) separately and set up the reactions.

substeps.instruction: For each locus, add 19 ul of Master Mix 1 and 1 ul of gDNA (10 ng/ul) to a PCR reaction tube or 96-well plate well

steps.title: Pool and Purify First-Round PCR Products
steps.instruction: Combine the PCR products from different loci for each sample and purify.

substeps.instruction: Pool 10 ul of PCR product from each locus (e.g. 18S and 28S) while keeping samples separate
Purify using a PCR clean-up kit (e.g. Zymo 96-well PCR Cleanup kit)

steps.title: Prepare Final Library for Sequencing
steps.instruction: Pool and clean the second-round PCR products for Illumina MiSeq submission.

substeps.instruction: Pool 5 ul of second-round PCR product from each sample
Clean half of this pool using a PCR cleanup kit (e.g. Zymo PCR Cleanup kit)
Elute in 30 ul elution buffer (EB), pH 8.0
Optional: Gel purify a large portion of the cleaned second-round PCR products to target >500 bp bands and minimize <200 bp dimers
